title: Slash feature card
description: A dark slate card with 10px corners, a hairline border and a faint diagonal gradient: an art area on top, then either a semibold title over grey text or one paragraph opening with a white lead-in; an optional slot above the copy for chips.
notes: the art area height is set per card (mediaHeight / mediaHeightSm); empty art shows a soft wash
name: slash-feature-card

props.name: title
props.description: the feature's name: a heading line ("stacked") or a white lead-in to the text ("inline")

props.name: note
props.description: a small footnote mark after the title or text ("2")

props.name: media
props.description: the art above the copy; a soft wash stands in when empty

props.name: extra
props.description: small extra content just above the copy (e.g. tier chips)

props.name: layout
props.description: stacked: semibold title over 16px text; inline: one 18px paragraph with a white lead-in

props.name: mediaHeight
props.description: height of the art area on desktop, as a CSS length (e.g. "17rem"); phones use `mediaHeightSm`

props.name: mediaHeightSm
props.description: height of the art area on phones

props.name: mediaPosition
props.description: top: art above the copy; behind: art fills the card and the copy sits over its lower left (the card is then at least mediaHeight tall)

props.name: style
props.description: inline styles for the card (e.g. a custom property the parent's classes read)
